Chat request with max_tokens=1 terminates with length finish_reason

```elixir title="Elixir"
api_key = System.fetch_env!("API_KEY")
{:ok, client} = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = LiterLlm.defaultclient_chat_async(client, "{\"max_tokens\":1,\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Write a story\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\"}")
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.choices, 0).finish_reason)
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.choices, 0).message.content)
```
